past.company_description: K12 Techno Services Pvt. Ltd. is a leading education services provider in India, offering comprehensive support to K–12 schools across academic, administrative, technological, and operational domains. Established in 2010 and headquartered in Bengaluru, the company partners with educational institutions to create high-quality, student-focused learning environments.With a network of 110+ schools across major metro cities including Hyderabad, Chennai, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Gurgaon, Kolkata, and Pune, K12 Techno Services plays a significant role in enabling educational excellence at scale. Its integrated approach helps schools operate more efficiently while delivering better learning outcomes.Backed by renowned investors such as Kedaara Capital, Kenro Capital, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India), and Navneet Learning LLP, the company reflects a strong foundation of trust, growth, and long-term vision.Driven by a culture of innovation, K12 brings together creative and committed professionals who are constantly working to build better learning ecosystems. From academic enrichment to institutional transformation, the organization is focused on reshaping school education in India through forward-thinking strategies and scalable execution.K12 Techno Services continues to be a trusted partner for schools seeking to elevate their standards, streamline operations, and prepare students for the challenges of tomorrow.
